source: Disposable synthetic Git repository and project; controller holds an ordinary actor credential, installed Codex account supplies model access

earlierAttempt.finding: Verifier inspected exact file and calculated 6*7, but the fixture omitted managed:true and therefore required generic producer write permission for its review action.
earlierAttempt.correction: The fixture uses managed ownership with transactional write/review guards and a trusted-source admin capture guard. No production permission relaxation.

timing: Native acceptance ran before the final declared-workspace-mode projection/UI correction. That correction is covered by final deterministic checks and separate UI verification.
limits: Synthetic managed workflow with fixture step.finish/step.verify tools; not the production Reviews plugin or an experiment/reflection/consolidation program
One private Git object store on one machine; no cross-machine object transfer
Native worker edits files and Runner commits stopped-worker WIP; agent git add/commit/merge are not implemented by this proof
Capture and a read-only verification handoff do not implement independently reviewed central publication
